module_summary: Valid/ready stream wrapper around a circular-buffer FIFO: push/pop are gated by full/empty, which also drive ready_o and valid_o.

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Input payload pushed into the FIFO

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Input valid generating push when not full

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Input ready, asserted while FIFO not full

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Output valid, asserted while FIFO not empty

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Output ready generating pop when not empty

anchors.name: push
anchors.why: FIFO write enable from valid_i and not full

anchors.name: pop
anchors.why: FIFO read enable from ready_i and not empty

groups.name: FIFO buffer
groups.description: Circular-buffer FIFO storage with pointers and occupancy

groups.name: Stream handshake logic
groups.description: Maps valid/ready to push/pop gated by full/empty
